scripts.art:check: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p "test_pixel_*.py" && python3 scripts/build-pixel-atlas.py --check && node --import tsx scripts/pack-styled-art.ts --check
scripts.predev: npm run wasm:build && npm run art:build
scripts.prebuild: npm run wasm:build:release && npm run art:build
scripts.ai:rust:build: node --import tsx .agents/skills/rust-toolchain/scripts/with-toolchain.ts cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --bin hex-command-sim
scripts.check:rust: node --import tsx .agents/skills/rust-toolchain/scripts/with-toolchain.ts cargo test --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --features wasm
scripts.wasm:build: node --import tsx .agents/skills/rust-toolchain/scripts/with-toolchain.ts wasm-pack build rust --target web --dev --out-dir pkg --out-name hex_command --no-pack --no-opt --locked --features wasm
scripts.wasm:build:release: node --import tsx .agents/skills/rust-toolchain/scripts/with-toolchain.ts wasm-pack build rust --target web --release --out-dir pkg --out-name hex_command --no-pack --no-opt --locked --features wasm
scripts.check:wasm: npm run wasm:build && tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler rust/pkg/hex_command.d.ts
